content_html:
I recently watched a coding agent refuse to start an approved implementation.

The work plan contained this:

## WorkPlan Review

- **Status**: approved (2026-08-02)

The agent found the line and understood the word approved. Then it asked for approval again because the workflow expected a field named Implementation Approval.Status.

Nothing was missing in substance. The label was wrong.

The agent was following a repository-resident workflow I had designed to carry a change through requirements, design, review, planning, and implementation. I had spent months adding status fields, handoff contracts, review gates, retry rules, and escalation paths. Each addition addressed a failure I had actually seen. Together, they had made the workflow brittle enough to stop on a heading.

I had built the system around an old question: how do I stop the model from losing the path?

The model could now follow the path. My path had become the problem.

Two kinds of constraint

The approval incident exposed a distinction I had missed.

A boundary constraint reduces the solution space:

  • Preserve the public API contract.
  • Do not perform an irreversible external action without authority.
  • Implement the confirmed requirements and keep recorded non-goals out of scope.
  • Treat the task as complete only when the required behavior is observable.

A work-generating constraint creates obligations:

  • Always produce three alternatives.
  • Require unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for every feature.
  • Require a mitigation task, owner, rollback plan, and approval record for every risk.
  • Resolve every review finding before continuing.
  • Stop when an optional field is absent or uses an unexpected label.

Both can look like safeguards. They behave very differently once the model is capable of carrying them out.

Boundary constraints tell the agent where it may operate. Work-generating constraints are read as requested work. A reliable agent will reliably create the extra artifacts, tests, abstractions, and stop conditions they imply.

That gave me the principle I now use when changing an agent workflow:

Be strict about boundaries and evidence. Be flexible about the path between them.

Why the problem surfaced now

The capability shift behind this is real, although public measurement often trails the models people are using.

METR's task-completion time horizon shows a strong historical increase in the difficulty of software tasks that agents can complete. METR also warns that the benchmark covers well-specified tasks, that capability remains jagged, and that new releases may go unmeasured for weeks or be skipped entirely. As of August 2, its public page was still dated May 8, and even its list of recent unmeasured models had not caught up with later releases.

Actual usage has moved toward longer execution as well. An analysis of roughly 400,000 coding-agent sessions found a recognizable division of labor: people made most planning decisions, while agents made most execution decisions. The authors describe it as people deciding what to build and the agent deciding how to build it.

Neither source proves how today's models behave in my workflow. The model families involved in the failures described here were released after the measurements and benchmarks I found. I did not find a public rerun on those releases.

That timing matters most for FixedBench. In May 2026, the researchers tested five then-current coding models on 200 issues where the code had already been fixed. The agents still made undesirable changes in 35% to 65% of cases. It is useful evidence that action bias existed in that generation. It is not a current failure rate.

The more interesting result is what happened when the researchers changed the instruction. Telling the agents to verify first and treat abstention as success reduced edits to already-correct code. On partially fixed code, the same instruction made them abstain when more work was still required. Prompt engineering traded action bias for passivity.

That is exactly the trap I had created in my own workflow. A model failed once, so I encoded the opposite behavior as a universal rule. When the model or task changed, the compensation remained.

The strongest evidence here comes from the failure history of this workflow on the current models I use. The studies explain why those failures are plausible and why simple prompt fixes decay. They do not substitute for observing the system itself.

How reliability started manufacturing work

The strict approval field was only the most visible failure.

In another run, the workflow stopped before implementation because it could not find external accounting evidence, document approval records, an exact release command, and detailed E2E environment assumptions. The repository, local services, and test tools were available. Most of the implementation could have proceeded. The workflow had converted useful planning context into mandatory readiness gates, then treated every missing gate as a user-owned decision.

The documents had expanded too. Product requirements and design docs started collecting stakeholder approval, live-service access, release procedures, dashboards, and operational evidence. A work plan for a data-export change included account setup and production concerns even though the requested outcome ended at implementation.

Review made the expansion worse. During that same planning flow, a reviewer requested a deterministic 20,000-row proof. The planner accepted the finding without asking what decision the proof would change or whether a cheaper boundary check would be enough. The reviewer then found that the proposed proof data contradicted an existing aggregation contract, which triggered another revision. Every step was technically defensible. The loop itself had no economic judgment.

I had made the reviewer authoritative and the author obedient. “Review until approved” had become “add work until the reviewer runs out of ideas.”

That is not convergence. It is a ratchet.

What I changed

I did not solve this by deleting every rule. I changed where the workflow is strict.

Decide the outcome before designing the solution

A user request is no longer accepted as an automatically valid implementation scope. Before design, the workflow records:

  • the observable outcome;
  • what is required now;
  • what describes the current state, a desired future, or speculation;
  • explicit non-goals;
  • a rough view of implementation cost and structural impact.

The cost assessment stays rough because this is requirements work, not detailed estimation. Its job is to make a bad tradeoff visible while scope is still cheap to remove.

“No change” and “reuse what already exists” are valid conclusions, but neither is a default. The agent must inspect enough evidence to decide whether the outcome is already satisfied, partially satisfied, or still requires implementation. That avoids turning FixedBench's action bias into its mirror image.

This also changes what users need to communicate. A useful request contains the boundary of the current outcome, not just a list of desired features. “Extend the existing authentication path without changing the public response contract” is more valuable than a long list of implementation rules. It states both the result and the point at which design needs to be reconsidered.

Give the model decisions, not a predicted route

The old workflow described complete routes: run one agent, populate every field, run another agent, stop on any missing input, repeat until a serialized state appears.

I now try to give each phase four things:

  • the purpose it owns;
  • the evidence that can change its decision;
  • the criteria for choosing the next action;
  • the smallest result the next consumer needs.

“Run every test lane” predicts a route. “Use the narrowest test that observes the required boundary” provides a decision criterion. Exact schemas still matter where software parses the response. A human-readable work plan does not need to fail because two headings express the same approved state. I changed the approval check to accept semantically equivalent evidence instead of requiring one heading.

The main agent also owns lightweight resolution. It can interpret semantically equivalent states, resolve repository-local ambiguity, retry with new evidence, and continue unaffected work. User escalation is reserved for decisions that belong to the user: a changed product outcome, a new requirement, a major approved design change, unavailable authority, or an irreversible external action.

Let review findings be declined

The receiver of a review now has three choices:

  • Apply a finding that contradicts an approved requirement, accepted design, repository rule, or observable correctness.
  • Decline a finding that adds scope, reverses an exclusion, duplicates proof, requests optional hardening, or costs more than its observable effect justifies.
  • Return for user decision when resolution changes the product outcome or a major approved decision.

A decline includes evidence and goes back to the reviewer. The reviewer may maintain the finding when that evidence still leaves the result incorrect or unverifiable. Repeating the same preference without new evidence does not block the workflow.

A useful review process preserves a basic engineering skill: deciding not to implement a technically reasonable suggestion.

The constraint I had to put back

Removing rules can be just as careless as adding them. I proved that during this rewrite.

The planning flow generated integration and E2E test skeletons so the first vertical slice could prove an acceptance criterion across a real boundary as early as possible.

After I simplified the handoff, the planner treated the generated test skeleton as an unrelated file and planned a new E2E test later in the project. The artifact still existed, so the workflow looked complete. Its reason for existing had disappeared.

I restored the skeleton's purpose in the planner: consume the exact generated file in the earliest task that can make its boundary executable. Shared infrastructure may come first only when no acceptance criterion can work without it, and only the infrastructure needed by that first slice belongs there.

This is a boundary constraint worth keeping. It connects a planned implementation to observable proof and prevents integration risk from being postponed until every component has been built. Removing it made the workflow smaller and less reliable.

What remains strict

Several controls still earn their cost:

  • User approval for product requirements and major design decisions.
  • Explicit authority and mechanical containment for irreversible actions.
  • Exact schemas at genuinely machine-consumed boundaries.
  • Plans for work with real dependencies.
  • Early vertical proof of an accepted outcome.
  • Observable verification before completion.
  • Independent review where a separate perspective can catch false confidence.

For dangerous operations, sandboxes, restricted credentials, isolated filesystems, and network controls are stronger than long prompt instructions. They limit the blast radius even when judgment is imperfect. Repeated approval prompts are a weaker substitute: one implementation report describes high approval rates and declining attention, and responds by using automated judgment to reduce routine prompts.

The same division applies to the workflow as a whole. Enforce the durable boundary mechanically where possible. Let the model choose among reversible actions inside it. An account of an agent-first engineering environment uses a similar principle: treat the top-level instructions as a table of contents rather than an encyclopedia.

The four questions I now ask

I now use four questions when reviewing an existing rule:

  1. What changes if I remove it? Name the decision, irreversible boundary, downstream consumer, or observable failure it affects.
  2. Does it limit scope or create work? Keep durable boundaries. Require current evidence before generating artifacts, test lanes, approval records, retry loops, or operational tasks.
  3. Can the model choose from evidence? Replace exhaustive branches with a purpose and selection criteria when the choice is reversible.
  4. Does it work in a fresh session? Rerun a representative task from the beginning. Continuing the old conversation only proves that a human can steer around the failure.

The fresh-session test has to cover both sides. A small change should remain small, ordinary ambiguity should not return to the user, and optional review findings should not expand scope. Required tests, approvals, and quality checks must still run. Fewer rules are not evidence of a better workflow.

A workflow can become technical debt

The hardest lesson for me was that reliability work can itself become overengineering.

Every workflow rule depends on an assumption about model behavior. A rule added after yesterday's failure can become redundant when the model improves, or harmful when a different task needs the opposite judgment. Status fields and review gates add coupling just as surely as public interfaces and shared abstractions do.

Boundary constraints age better because they describe what must remain true: the approved outcome, the public contract, the authority available, and the evidence required for completion. The route between those boundaries can change with the model.

I no longer ask only whether a new rule would have prevented the last failure. I also ask what work it will create, what decision it will remove from the model, and whether it will still make sense after the failure mode disappears.

The job of an agent workflow is no longer to make a model capable of finishing the process. It is to help a capable model finish the right amount of work.

sentences.en: The capability shift behind this is real, although public measurement often trails the models people are using.
sentences.zh: 尽管公共测量常常落后于人们正在使用的模型，但这背后的能力转变是真实的。

blocks.html_en: METR's task-completion time horizon shows a strong historical increase in the difficulty of software tasks that agents can complete. METR also warns that the benchmark covers well-specified tasks, that capability remains jagged, and that new releases may go unmeasured for weeks or be skipped entirely. As of August 2, its public page was still dated May 8, and even its list of recent unmeasured models had not caught up with later releases.

sentences.en: METR's task-completion time horizon shows a strong historical increase in the difficulty of software tasks that agents can complete.
sentences.zh: METR 的任务完成时间范围显示代理可以完成的软件任务的难度在历史上出现了强劲增长。

sentences.en: METR also warns that the benchmark covers well-specified tasks, that capability remains jagged, and that new releases may go unmeasured for weeks or be skipped entirely.
sentences.zh: METR 还警告说，该基准测试涵盖了明确指定的任务，该功能仍然参差不齐，并且新版本可能会在数周内得不到测量或完全被跳过。

sentences.en: As of August 2, its public page was still dated May 8, and even its list of recent unmeasured models had not caught up with later releases.
sentences.zh: 截至 8 月 2 日，其公共页面的日期仍然是 5 月 8 日，甚至其近期未测量型号的列表也没有赶上后来发布的。

blocks.html_en: Actual usage has moved toward longer execution as well. An analysis of roughly 400,000 coding-agent sessions found a recognizable division of labor: people made most planning decisions, while agents made most execution decisions. The authors describe it as people deciding what to build and the agent deciding how to build it.

sentences.en: Actual usage has moved toward longer execution as well.
sentences.zh: 实际使用也已转向更长的执行时间。

sentences.en: An analysis of roughly 400,000 coding-agent sessions found a recognizable division of labor: people made most planning decisions, while agents made most execution decisions.
sentences.zh: 对大约 400,000 个编码代理会话的分析发现了明显的分工：人们做出了大部分规划决策，而代理做出了大部分执行决策。

sentences.en: The authors describe it as people deciding what to build and the agent deciding how to build it.
sentences.zh: 作者将其描述为人们决定构建什么，而代理决定如何构建它。

blocks.html_en: Neither source proves how today's models behave in my workflow. The model families involved in the failures described here were released after the measurements and benchmarks I found. I did not find a public rerun on those releases.

sentences.en: Neither source proves how today's models behave in my workflow.
sentences.zh: 这两个来源都没有证明当今的模型在我的工作流程中的表现如何。

sentences.en: The model families involved in the failures described here were released after the measurements and benchmarks I found.
sentences.zh: 此处描述的故障涉及的模型系列是在我找到的测量和基准之后发布的。

sentences.en: I did not find a public rerun on those releases.
sentences.zh: 我没有找到这些版本的公开重播。

blocks.html_en: That timing matters most for FixedBench. In May 2026, the researchers tested five then-current coding models on 200 issues where the code had already been fixed. The agents still made undesirable changes in 35% to 65% of cases. It is useful evidence that action bias existed in that generation. It is not a current failure rate.

sentences.en: That timing matters most for FixedBench.
sentences.zh: 对于固定基准来说，这个时机最重要。

sentences.en: In May 2026, the researchers tested five then-current coding models on 200 issues where the code had already been fixed.
sentences.zh: 2026 年 5 月，研究人员针对 200 个问题测试了 5 个当时流行的编码模型，其中代码已经得到修复。

sentences.en: The agents still made undesirable changes in 35% to 65% of cases.
sentences.zh: 在 35% 到 65% 的情况下，代理人仍然做出了不良的改变。

sentences.en: It is useful evidence that action bias existed in that generation.
sentences.zh: 这是证明那一代人存在行动偏见的有用证据。

sentences.en: It is not a current failure rate.
sentences.zh: 这不是当前的故障率。

blocks.html_en: The more interesting result is what happened when the researchers changed the instruction. Telling the agents to verify first and treat abstention as success reduced edits to already-correct code. On partially fixed code, the same instruction made them abstain when more work was still required. Prompt engineering traded action bias for passivity.

sentences.en: The more interesting result is what happened when the researchers changed the instruction.
sentences.zh: 更有趣的结果是研究人员改变指令时发生的情况。

sentences.en: Telling the agents to verify first and treat abstention as success reduced edits to already-correct code.
sentences.zh: 告诉特工首先进行验证并将弃权视为成功，减少了对已经正确的代码的编辑。

sentences.en: On partially fixed code, the same instruction made them abstain when more work was still required.
sentences.zh: 对于部分固定的代码，当仍需要更多工作时，相同的指令使他们放弃。

sentences.en: Prompt engineering traded action bias for passivity.
sentences.zh: 提示工程用行动偏见换取被动。

blocks.html_en: That is exactly the trap I had created in my own workflow. A model failed once, so I encoded the opposite behavior as a universal rule. When the model or task changed, the compensation remained.

sentences.en: That is exactly the trap I had created in my own workflow.
sentences.zh: 这正是我在自己的工作流程中创建的陷阱。

sentences.en: A model failed once, so I encoded the opposite behavior as a universal rule.
sentences.zh: 模型失败过一次，所以我将相反的行为编码为通用规则。

sentences.en: When the model or task changed, the compensation remained.
sentences.zh: 当模型或任务发生变化时，补偿仍然存在。

blocks.html_en: The strongest evidence here comes from the failure history of this workflow on the current models I use. The studies explain why those failures are plausible and why simple prompt fixes decay. They do not substitute for observing the system itself.

sentences.en: The strongest evidence here comes from the failure history of this workflow on the current models I use.
sentences.zh: 这里最有力的证据来自于我当前使用的模型上此工作流程的失败历史记录。

sentences.en: The studies explain why those failures are plausible and why simple prompt fixes decay.
sentences.zh: 这些研究解释了为什么这些失败是合理的，以及为什么简单的即时修复会失效。

sentences.en: They do not substitute for observing the system itself.
sentences.zh: 它们不能代替观察系统本身。

blocks.html_en: How reliability started manufacturing work

sentences.en: How reliability started manufacturing work
sentences.zh: 可靠性如何开始制造工作

blocks.html_en: The strict approval field was only the most visible failure.

sentences.en: The strict approval field was only the most visible failure.
sentences.zh: 严格的审批领域只是最明显的失败。

blocks.html_en: In another run, the workflow stopped before implementation because it could not find external accounting evidence, document approval records, an exact release command, and detailed E2E environment assumptions. The repository, local services, and test tools were available. Most of the implementation could have proceeded. The workflow had converted useful planning context into mandatory readiness gates, then treated every missing gate as a user-owned decision.

sentences.en: In another run, the workflow stopped before implementation because it could not find external accounting evidence, document approval records, an exact release command, and detailed E2E environment assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在另一次运行中，工作流程在实施之前停止，因为它找不到外部会计证据、文档审批记录、准确的发布命令和详细的端到端环境假设。

sentences.en: The repository, local services, and test tools were available.
sentences.zh: 存储库、本地服务和测试工具均可用。

sentences.en: Most of the implementation could have proceeded.
sentences.zh: 大部分实施工作本来可以继续进行。

sentences.en: The workflow had converted useful planning context into mandatory readiness gates, then treated every missing gate as a user-owned decision.
sentences.zh: 工作流程已将有用的规划上下文转换为强制准备就绪门，然后将每个缺失的门视为用户拥有的决策。

blocks.html_en: The documents had expanded too. Product requirements and design docs started collecting stakeholder approval, live-service access, release procedures, dashboards, and operational evidence. A work plan for a data-export change included account setup and production concerns even though the requested outcome ended at implementation.

sentences.en: The documents had expanded too.
sentences.zh: 文件也扩大了。

sentences.en: Product requirements and design docs started collecting stakeholder approval, live-service access, release procedures, dashboards, and operational evidence.
sentences.zh: 产品需求和设计文档开始收集利益相关者的批准、实时服务访问、发布程序、仪表板和操作证据。

sentences.en: A work plan for a data-export change included account setup and production concerns even though the requested outcome ended at implementation.
sentences.zh: 数据导出变更的工作计划包括帐户设置和生产问题，即使所要求的结果在实施时结束。

blocks.html_en: Review made the expansion worse. During that same planning flow, a reviewer requested a deterministic 20,000-row proof. The planner accepted the finding without asking what decision the proof would change or whether a cheaper boundary check would be enough. The reviewer then found that the proposed proof data contradicted an existing aggregation contract, which triggered another revision. Every step was technically defensible. The loop itself had no economic judgment.

sentences.en: Review made the expansion worse.
sentences.zh: 审查使扩张变得更糟。

sentences.en: During that same planning flow, a reviewer requested a deterministic 20,000-row proof.
sentences.zh: 在同一规划流程中，审阅者要求提供确定性的 20,000 行证明。

sentences.en: The planner accepted the finding without asking what decision the proof would change or whether a cheaper boundary check would be enough.
sentences.zh: 规划者接受了这一发现，但没有询问证明将改变什么决定，或者更便宜的边界检查是否足够。

sentences.en: The reviewer then found that the proposed proof data contradicted an existing aggregation contract, which triggered another revision.
sentences.zh: 审查者随后发现提议的证明数据与现有的聚合合约相矛盾，从而引发了另一次修订。

sentences.en: Every step was technically defensible.
sentences.zh: 每一步在技术上都是站得住脚的。

sentences.en: The loop itself had no economic judgment.
sentences.zh: 循环本身没有经济判断力。

blocks.html_en: I had made the reviewer authoritative and the author obedient. “Review until approved” had become “add work until the reviewer runs out of ideas.”

sentences.en: I had made the reviewer authoritative and the author obedient.
sentences.zh: 我让审稿人变得权威，让作者变得顺从。

sentences.en: “Review until approved” had become “add work until the reviewer runs out of ideas.”
sentences.zh: “审核直到批准”变成了“添加工作直到审核者没有想法”。

blocks.html_en: That is not convergence. It is a ratchet.

sentences.en: That is not convergence.
sentences.zh: 那不是收敛。

sentences.en: It is a ratchet.
sentences.zh: 它是一个棘轮。

blocks.html_en: What I changed

sentences.en: What I changed
sentences.zh: 我改变了什么

blocks.html_en: I did not solve this by deleting every rule. I changed where the workflow is strict.

sentences.en: I did not solve this by deleting every rule.
sentences.zh: 我并没有通过删除每条规则来解决这个问题。

sentences.en: I changed where the workflow is strict.
sentences.zh: 我改变了工作流程严格的地方。

blocks.html_en: Decide the outcome before designing the solution

sentences.en: Decide the outcome before designing the solution
sentences.zh: 在设计解决方案之前确定结果

blocks.html_en: A user request is no longer accepted as an automatically valid implementation scope. Before design, the workflow records:

sentences.en: A user request is no longer accepted as an automatically valid implementation scope.
sentences.zh: 用户请求不再被接受为自动有效的实施范围。

sentences.en: Before design, the workflow records:
sentences.zh: 设计前，工作流程记录：

blocks.html_en: • the observable outcome;

sentences.en: the observable outcome;
sentences.zh: 可观察到的结果；

blocks.html_en: • what is required now;

sentences.en: what is required now;
sentences.zh: 现在需要什么；

blocks.html_en: • what describes the current state, a desired future, or speculation;

sentences.en: what describes the current state, a desired future, or speculation;
sentences.zh: 什么描述了当前状态、期望的未来或推测；

blocks.html_en: • explicit non-goals;

sentences.en: explicit non-goals;
sentences.zh: 明确的非目标；

blocks.html_en: • a rough view of implementation cost and structural impact.

sentences.en: a rough view of implementation cost and structural impact.
sentences.zh: 对实施成本和结构影响的粗略看法。

blocks.html_en: The cost assessment stays rough because this is requirements work, not detailed estimation. Its job is to make a bad tradeoff visible while scope is still cheap to remove.

sentences.en: The cost assessment stays rough because this is requirements work, not detailed estimation.
sentences.zh: 成本评估仍然是粗略的，因为这是需求工作，而不是详细的估算。

sentences.en: Its job is to make a bad tradeoff visible while scope is still cheap to remove.
sentences.zh: 它的工作是让一个糟糕的权衡变得可见，同时删除范围仍然很便宜。

blocks.html_en: “No change” and “reuse what already exists” are valid conclusions, but neither is a default. The agent must inspect enough evidence to decide whether the outcome is already satisfied, partially satisfied, or still requires implementation. That avoids turning FixedBench's action bias into its mirror image.

sentences.en: “No change” and “reuse what already exists” are valid conclusions, but neither is a default.
sentences.zh: “不改变”和“重用已经存在的东西”是有效的结论，但都不是默认的。

sentences.en: The agent must inspect enough evidence to decide whether the outcome is already satisfied, partially satisfied, or still requires implementation.
sentences.zh: 代理必须检查足够的证据来决定结果是已经满意、部分满意还是仍然需要实施。

sentences.en: That avoids turning FixedBench's action bias into its mirror image.
sentences.zh: 这避免了将FixedBench 的动作偏差变成其镜像。

blocks.html_en: This also changes what users need to communicate. A useful request contains the boundary of the current outcome, not just a list of desired features. “Extend the existing authentication path without changing the public response contract” is more valuable than a long list of implementation rules. It states both the result and the point at which design needs to be reconsidered.

sentences.en: This also changes what users need to communicate.
sentences.zh: 这也改变了用户需要沟通的内容。

sentences.en: A useful request contains the boundary of the current outcome, not just a list of desired features.
sentences.zh: 有用的请求包含当前结果的边界，而不仅仅是所需功能的列表。

sentences.en: “Extend the existing authentication path without changing the public response contract” is more valuable than a long list of implementation rules.
sentences.zh: “在不改变公共响应合约的情况下扩展现有的身份验证路径”比一长串实施规则更有价值。

sentences.en: It states both the result and the point at which design needs to be reconsidered.
sentences.zh: 它说明了结果以及需要重新考虑设计的点。

blocks.html_en: Give the model decisions, not a predicted route

sentences.en: Give the model decisions, not a predicted route
sentences.zh: 给出模型决策，而不是预测路线

blocks.html_en: The old workflow described complete routes: run one agent, populate every field, run another agent, stop on any missing input, repeat until a serialized state appears.

sentences.en: The old workflow described complete routes: run one agent, populate every field, run another agent, stop on any missing input, repeat until a serialized state appears.
sentences.zh: 旧的工作流程描述了完整的路线：运行一个代理，填充每个字段，运行另一个代理，在任何丢失的输入上停止，重复直到出现序列化状态。

blocks.html_en: I now try to give each phase four things:

sentences.en: I now try to give each phase four things:
sentences.zh: 我现在尝试为每个阶段提供四件事：

blocks.html_en: • the purpose it owns;

sentences.en: the purpose it owns;
sentences.zh: 它所拥有的目的；

blocks.html_en: • the evidence that can change its decision;

sentences.en: the evidence that can change its decision;
sentences.zh: 可以改变其决定的证据；

blocks.html_en: • the criteria for choosing the next action;

sentences.en: the criteria for choosing the next action;
sentences.zh: 选择下一步行动的标准；

blocks.html_en: • the smallest result the next consumer needs.

sentences.en: the smallest result the next consumer needs.
sentences.zh: 下一个消费者需要的最小结果。

blocks.html_en: “Run every test lane” predicts a route. “Use the narrowest test that observes the required boundary” provides a decision criterion. Exact schemas still matter where software parses the response. A human-readable work plan does not need to fail because two headings express the same approved state. I changed the approval check to accept semantically equivalent evidence instead of requiring one heading.

sentences.en: “Run every test lane” predicts a route.
sentences.zh: “运行每条测试车道”预测一条路线。

sentences.en: “Use the narrowest test that observes the required boundary” provides a decision criterion.
sentences.zh: “使用遵守所需边界的最窄测试”提供了决策标准。

sentences.en: Exact schemas still matter where software parses the response.
sentences.zh: 在软件解析响应的地方，精确的模式仍然很重要。

sentences.en: A human-readable work plan does not need to fail because two headings express the same approved state.
sentences.zh: 人类可读的工作计划不需要失败，因为两个标题表达了相同的批准状态。

sentences.en: I changed the approval check to accept semantically equivalent evidence instead of requiring one heading.
sentences.zh: 我更改了批准检查以接受语义等效的证据，而不是要求一个标题。

blocks.html_en: The main agent also owns lightweight resolution. It can interpret semantically equivalent states, resolve repository-local ambiguity, retry with new evidence, and continue unaffected work. User escalation is reserved for decisions that belong to the user: a changed product outcome, a new requirement, a major approved design change, unavailable authority, or an irreversible external action.

sentences.en: The main agent also owns lightweight resolution.
sentences.zh: 主代理还拥有轻量级解析。

sentences.en: It can interpret semantically equivalent states, resolve repository-local ambiguity, retry with new evidence, and continue unaffected work.
sentences.zh: 它可以解释语义上等效的状态，解决存储库本地歧义，使用新证据重试，并继续不受影响的工作。

sentences.en: User escalation is reserved for decisions that belong to the user: a changed product outcome, a new requirement, a major approved design change, unavailable authority, or an irreversible external action.
sentences.zh: 用户升级保留用于属于用户的决策：更改的产品结果、新的要求、已批准的主要设计更改、不可用的权限或不可逆转的外部操作。

blocks.html_en: Let review findings be declined

sentences.en: Let review findings be declined
sentences.zh: 让审查结果被拒绝

blocks.html_en: The receiver of a review now has three choices:

sentences.en: The receiver of a review now has three choices:
sentences.zh: 评论的接收者现在有三个选择：

blocks.html_en: • Apply a finding that contradicts an approved requirement, accepted design, repository rule, or observable correctness.

sentences.en: Apply a finding that contradicts an approved requirement, accepted design, repository rule, or observable correctness.
sentences.zh: 应用与已批准的要求、已接受的设计、存储库规则或可观察的正确性相矛盾的发现。

blocks.html_en: • Decline a finding that adds scope, reverses an exclusion, duplicates proof, requests optional hardening, or costs more than its observable effect justifies.

sentences.en: Decline a finding that adds scope, reverses an exclusion, duplicates proof, requests optional hardening, or costs more than its observable effect justifies.
sentences.zh: 拒绝增加范围、推翻排除、重复证明、请求可选强化或成本超过其可观察到的效果合理的调查结果。

blocks.html_en: • Return for user decision when resolution changes the product outcome or a major approved decision.

sentences.en: Return for user decision when resolution changes the product outcome or a major approved decision.
sentences.zh: 当决议改变产品结果或重大批准决策时，返回用户决策。

blocks.html_en: A decline includes evidence and goes back to the reviewer. The reviewer may maintain the finding when that evidence still leaves the result incorrect or unverifiable. Repeating the same preference without new evidence does not block the workflow.

sentences.en: A decline includes evidence and goes back to the reviewer.
sentences.zh: 拒绝包括证据并返回给审阅者。

sentences.en: The reviewer may maintain the finding when that evidence still leaves the result incorrect or unverifiable.
sentences.zh: 当证据仍然表明结果不正确或无法验证时，审阅者可以维持该发现。

sentences.en: Repeating the same preference without new evidence does not block the workflow.
sentences.zh: 在没有新证据的情况下重复相同的首选项不会阻止工作流程。

blocks.html_en: A useful review process preserves a basic engineering skill: deciding not to implement a technically reasonable suggestion.

sentences.en: A useful review process preserves a basic engineering skill: deciding not to implement a technically reasonable suggestion.
sentences.zh: 有用的审查过程保留了基本的工程技能：决定不实施技术上合理的建议。

blocks.html_en: The constraint I had to put back

sentences.en: The constraint I had to put back
sentences.zh: 我必须放回的限制

blocks.html_en: Removing rules can be just as careless as adding them. I proved that during this rewrite.

sentences.en: Removing rules can be just as careless as adding them.
sentences.zh: 删除规则和添加规则一样不小心。

sentences.en: I proved that during this rewrite.
sentences.zh: 我在这次重写中证明了这一点。

blocks.html_en: The planning flow generated integration and E2E test skeletons so the first vertical slice could prove an acceptance criterion across a real boundary as early as possible.

sentences.en: The planning flow generated integration and E2E test skeletons so the first vertical slice could prove an acceptance criterion across a real boundary as early as possible.
sentences.zh: 规划流程生成集成和端到端测试框架，因此第一个垂直切片可以尽早证明跨越真实边界的验收标准。

blocks.html_en: After I simplified the handoff, the planner treated the generated test skeleton as an unrelated file and planned a new E2E test later in the project. The artifact still existed, so the workflow looked complete. Its reason for existing had disappeared.

sentences.en: After I simplified the handoff, the planner treated the generated test skeleton as an unrelated file and planned a new E2E test later in the project.
sentences.zh: 在我简化了交接之后，规划人员将生成的测试框架视为不相关的文件，并在项目后期规划了新的端到端测试。

sentences.en: The artifact still existed, so the workflow looked complete.
sentences.zh: 该工件仍然存在，因此工作流程看起来很完整。

sentences.en: Its reason for existing had disappeared.
sentences.zh: 它存在的理由已经消失了。

blocks.html_en: I restored the skeleton's purpose in the planner: consume the exact generated file in the earliest task that can make its boundary executable. Shared infrastructure may come first only when no acceptance criterion can work without it, and only the infrastructure needed by that first slice belongs there.

sentences.en: I restored the skeleton's purpose in the planner: consume the exact generated file in the earliest task that can make its boundary executable.
sentences.zh: 我在规划器中恢复了骨架的用途：在最早的任务中使用确切生成的文件，使其边界可执行。

sentences.en: Shared infrastructure may come first only when no acceptance criterion can work without it, and only the infrastructure needed by that first slice belongs there.
sentences.zh: 仅当没有共享基础设施就无法实现任何验收标准时，共享基础设施才可能是第一位的，并且只有第一个切片所需的基础设施才属于那里。

blocks.html_en: This is a boundary constraint worth keeping. It connects a planned implementation to observable proof and prevents integration risk from being postponed until every component has been built. Removing it made the workflow smaller and less reliable.

sentences.en: This is a boundary constraint worth keeping.
sentences.zh: 这是一个值得保留的边界约束。

sentences.en: It connects a planned implementation to observable proof and prevents integration risk from being postponed until every component has been built.

content_html_zh:
我最近看到一个编码代理拒绝启动已批准的实施。

工作计划包含以下内容：

## WorkPlan Review

- **Status**: approved (2026-08-02)

进入全屏模式 退出全屏模式

代理人找到了这条线路并理解了“批准”一词。 然后它再次请求批准，因为工作流需要一个名为“Implementation Approval.Status”的字段。

实质上没有缺失任何东西。 标签错误。

该代理遵循我设计的存储库驻留工作流程，用于通过需求、设计、审查、规划和实施进行更改。 我花了几个月的时间添加状态字段、移交合同、审查门、重试规则和升级路径。 每一个补充都解决了我实际看到的一个失败。 他们一起使工作流程变得脆弱到足以停止。

我围绕一个老问题构建了该系统：如何阻止模型丢失路径？

该模型现在可以遵循该路径。 我的道路成了问题。

两种约束

批准事件暴露了我忽略的一个区别。

边界约束减少了解空间：

  • 保留公共 API 合约。
  • 未经授权，请勿执行不可逆转的外部操作。
  • 实施已确认的要求并记录超出范围的非目标。
  • 仅当可观察到所需行为时，才将任务视为已完成。

创造工作的约束会产生义务：

  • 总是产生三种选择。
  • 需要对每个功能进行单元、集成和端到端测试。
  • 需要每个风险的缓解任务、所有者、回滚计划和批准记录。
  • 在继续之前解决每一个审查结果。
  • 当可选字段不存在或使用意外标签时停止。

两者看起来都像是保障措施。 一旦模型能够执行它们，它们的行为就会非常不同。

边界约束告诉代理它可以在哪里操作。 工作生成约束被视为请求的工作。 可靠的代理将可靠地创建它们暗示的额外工件、测试、抽象和停止条件。

这给了我现在在更改代理工作流程时使用的原则：

严格限制界限和证据。 对它们之间的路径保持灵活。

为什么问题现在才出现

尽管公共测量常常落后于人们正在使用的模型，但这背后的能力转变是真实的。

METR 的任务完成时间范围显示代理可以完成的软件任务的难度在历史上出现了强劲增长。 METR 还警告说，该基准测试涵盖了明确指定的任务，该功能仍然参差不齐，并且新版本可能会在数周内得不到测量或完全被跳过。 截至 8 月 2 日，其公共页面的日期仍然是 5 月 8 日，甚至其近期未测量型号的列表也没有赶上后来发布的。

实际使用也已转向更长的执行时间。 对大约 400,000 个编码代理会话的分析发现了明显的分工：人们做出了大部分规划决策，而代理做出了大部分执行决策。 作者将其描述为人们决定构建什么，而代理决定如何构建它。

这两个来源都没有证明当今的模型在我的工作流程中的表现如何。 此处描述的故障涉及的模型系列是在我找到的测量和基准之后发布的。 我没有找到这些版本的公开重播。

对于固定基准来说，这个时机最重要。 2026 年 5 月，研究人员针对 200 个问题测试了 5 个当时流行的编码模型，其中代码已经得到修复。 在 35% 到 65% 的情况下，代理人仍然做出了不良的改变。 这是证明那一代人存在行动偏见的有用证据。 这不是当前的故障率。

更有趣的结果是研究人员改变指令时发生的情况。 告诉特工首先进行验证并将弃权视为成功，减少了对已经正确的代码的编辑。 对于部分固定的代码，当仍需要更多工作时，相同的指令使他们放弃。 提示工程用行动偏见换取被动。

这正是我在自己的工作流程中创建的陷阱。 模型失败过一次，所以我将相反的行为编码为通用规则。 当模型或任务发生变化时，补偿仍然存在。

这里最有力的证据来自于我当前使用的模型上此工作流程的失败历史记录。 这些研究解释了为什么这些失败是合理的，以及为什么简单的即时修复会失效。 它们不能代替观察系统本身。

可靠性如何开始制造工作

严格的审批领域只是最明显的失败。

在另一次运行中，工作流程在实施之前停止，因为它找不到外部会计证据、文档审批记录、准确的发布命令和详细的端到端环境假设。 存储库、本地服务和测试工具均可用。 大部分实施工作本来可以继续进行。 工作流程已将有用的规划上下文转换为强制准备就绪门，然后将每个缺失的门视为用户拥有的决策。

文件也扩大了。 产品需求和设计文档开始收集利益相关者的批准、实时服务访问、发布程序、仪表板和操作证据。 数据导出变更的工作计划包括帐户设置和生产问题，即使所要求的结果在实施时结束。

审查使扩张变得更糟。 在同一规划流程中，审阅者要求提供确定性的 20,000 行证明。 规划者接受了这一发现，但没有询问证明将改变什么决定，或者更便宜的边界检查是否足够。 审查者随后发现提议的证明数据与现有的聚合合约相矛盾，从而引发了另一次修订。 每一步在技术上都是站得住脚的。 循环本身没有经济判断力。

我让审稿人变得权威，让作者变得顺从。 “审核直到批准”变成了“添加工作直到审核者没有想法”。

那不是收敛。 它是一个棘轮。

我改变了什么

我并没有通过删除每条规则来解决这个问题。 我改变了工作流程严格的地方。

在设计解决方案之前确定结果

用户请求不再被接受为自动有效的实施范围。 设计前，工作流程记录：

  • 可观察到的结果；
  • 现在需要什么；
  • 什么描述了当前状态、期望的未来或推测；
  • 明确的非目标；
  • 对实施成本和结构影响的粗略看法。

成本评估仍然是粗略的，因为这是需求工作，而不是详细的估算。 它的工作是让一个糟糕的权衡变得可见，同时删除范围仍然很便宜。

“不改变”和“重用已经存在的东西”是有效的结论，但都不是默认的。 代理必须检查足够的证据来决定结果是已经满意、部分满意还是仍然需要实施。 这避免了将FixedBench 的动作偏差变成其镜像。

这也改变了用户需要沟通的内容。 有用的请求包含当前结果的边界，而不仅仅是所需功能的列表。 “在不改变公共响应合约的情况下扩展现有的身份验证路径”比一长串实施规则更有价值。 它说明了结果以及需要重新考虑设计的点。

给出模型决策，而不是预测路线

旧的工作流程描述了完整的路线：运行一个代理，填充每个字段，运行另一个代理，在任何丢失的输入上停止，重复直到出现序列化状态。

我现在尝试为每个阶段提供四件事：

  • 它所拥有的目的；
  • 可以改变其决定的证据；
  • 选择下一步行动的标准；
  • 下一个消费者需要的最小结果。

“运行每条测试车道”预测一条路线。 “使用遵守所需边界的最窄测试”提供了决策标准。 在软件解析响应的地方，精确的模式仍然很重要。 人类可读的工作计划不需要失败，因为两个标题表达了相同的批准状态。 我更改了批准检查以接受语义等效的证据，而不是要求一个标题。

主代理还拥有轻量级解析。 它可以解释语义上等效的状态，解决存储库本地歧义，使用新证据重试，并继续不受影响的工作。 用户升级保留用于属于用户的决策：更改的产品结果、新的要求、已批准的主要设计更改、不可用的权限或不可逆转的外部操作。

让审查结果被拒绝

评论的接收者现在有三个选择：

  • 应用与已批准的要求、已接受的设计、存储库规则或可观察的正确性相矛盾的发现。
  • 拒绝增加范围、推翻排除、重复证明、请求可选强化或成本超过其可观察到的效果合理的调查结果。
  • 当决议改变产品结果或重大批准决策时，返回用户决策。

拒绝包括证据并返回给审阅者。 当证据仍然表明结果不正确或无法验证时，审阅者可以维持该发现。 在没有新证据的情况下重复相同的首选项不会阻止工作流程。

有用的审查过程保留了基本的工程技能：决定不实施技术上合理的建议。

我必须放回的限制

删除规则和添加规则一样不小心。 我在这次重写中证明了这一点。

规划流程生成集成和端到端测试框架，因此第一个垂直切片可以尽早证明跨越真实边界的验收标准。

在我简化了交接之后，规划人员将生成的测试框架视为不相关的文件，并在项目后期规划了新的端到端测试。 该工件仍然存在，因此工作流程看起来很完整。 它存在的理由已经消失了。

我在规划器中恢复了骨架的用途：在最早的任务中使用确切生成的文件，使其边界可执行。 仅当没有共享基础设施就无法实现任何验收标准时，共享基础设施才可能是第一位的，并且只有第一个切片所需的基础设施才属于那里。

这是一个值得保留的边界约束。 它将计划的实施与可观察的证据联系起来，并防止集成风险被推迟到每个组件都构建完成为止。 删除它会使工作流程更小且可靠性更低。

哪些仍然严格

有几个控件仍然会产生成本：

  • 用户批准产品要求和主要设计决策。
  • 对不可逆转行为的明确授权和机械遏制。
  • 真正机器消耗边界的精确模式。
  • 计划与真正的依赖关系一起工作。
  • 已接受结果的早期垂直证明。
  • 完成前可观察的验证。
  • 独立审查，单独的观点可能会发现错误的信心。

对于危险操作，沙箱、受限凭据、隔离文件系统和网络控制比长提示指令更强大。 即使判断不完善，它们也会限制爆炸半径。 重复的批准提示是较弱的替代方案：一份实施报告描述了高批准率和下降的关注度，并通过使用自动判断来减少常规提示进行响应。

相同的划分适用于整个工作流程。 尽可能以机械方式强制执行持久边界。 让模型在其内部的可逆动作中进行选择。 代理优先的工程环境的描述使用类似的原则：将顶级指令视为目录而不是百科全书。

我现在问的四个问题

现在，我在审查现有规则时会提出四个问题：

  1. 如果我删除它会发生什么变化？ 命名决策、不可逆边界、下游消费者或它影响的可观察故障。
  2. 它会限制范围还是创造工作？ 保持持久的界限。 在生成工件、测试通道、批准记录、重试循环或操作任务之前需要当前证据。
  3. 模型可以从证据中进行选择吗？ 当选择是可逆时，用目的和选择标准替换详尽的分支。
  4. 它在新会话中有效吗？ 从头开始重新运行代表性任务。 继续旧的对话只能证明人类可以绕过失败。

新会话测试必须覆盖双方。 小的改变应该保持很小，普通的歧义不应该返回给用户，可选的审查结果不应该扩大范围。 所需的测试、批准和质量检查仍然必须进行。 更少的规则并不代表更好的工作流程。

工作流程可能成为技术债务

对我来说最惨痛的教训是，可靠性工作本身就可能变得过度设计。

每个工作流规则都取决于有关模型行为的假设。 当模型改进时，昨天失败后添加的规则可能会变得多余，或者当不同的任务需要相反的判断时会变得有害。 状态字段和审查门就像公共接口和共享抽象一样肯定会增加耦合。

边界约束更容易老化，因为它们描述了必须保持真实的东西：批准的结果、公共合同、可用的权威以及完成所需的证据。 这些边界之间的路线可能会随着模型的变化而变化。

我不再只问新规则是否可以避免上次的失败。 我还询问它将创建什么工作，将从模型中删除什么决策，以及在故障模式消失后它是否仍然有意义。

代理工作流的工作不再是使模型能够完成该过程。 就是帮助有能力的模型完成适量的工作。
